prior_summary: Commanded TCP labels are converted to desired source-container increments using each observation's rigid container-to-TCP transform; decoding reattaches source motion through the fresh grasp transform before IK.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the source is securely and rigidly held but the observed container-to-TCP relation is unusual, or the predecessor provides a modestly displaced entry. Container, TCP and bowl poses must be reliable and compensated targets reachable.
termination_guidance: Hand off only after at least ten particles are observed settled, the source itself is approximately upright and held, and outbound motion has begun. Nominal return_place_release readiness is near action 1680 within [1460,1740).
limitations: The rigid-transform assumption fails for slip or grasp loss, and compensation can amplify pose noise. Source-local increments are not an absolute large-displacement destination anchor; h01 covers that case. Particle phase ambiguity is handled more explicitly by h02. Training grasps are nominal, so unusual-grasp benefit is expected, not demonstrated.
